dataset.source: Binance USD-M public WebSocket exchange timestamps
dataset.collector_requirement: v2 only; the predecessor's forceOrder route was broken

parent_event.cascade: same-side actual forceOrder observations separated by no more than three seconds
parent_event.tail: cascade notional at or above the shifted expanding 95th percentile after at least twenty prior cascades
parent_event.delivery: ordinary trade return and active flow both align with the liquidation direction

state_transition.confirmation: strictly later completed second with opposite trade return, opposite active flow, price leaving the liquidation extreme, opposite best-quote imbalance and opposite microprice premium without a worse spread
state_transition.unresolved: any missing or incoherent trade/book state is no-trade

geometry.invalidation: liquidation cascade trade-price extreme plus one basis-point buffer
geometry.target: last trade close immediately before the cascade

limitations: two preserved dates provide a diagnostic and a locked fresh screen, not long-term evidence
no account or success claim is allowed without NautilusTrader promotion and longer continuous data
